verdict.rationale: Data-use privacy is a fair question for any app that sends data to its vendor, so this axis applies to an authenticator. However, the evidence never mentions AI model training or any control over it. The only nearby control is an optional 'Usage Data' toggle for sharing non-personal usage data, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
